newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ahern's Fianna Fail/PD alliance short of majority.
newsitem.headline: Ahern's Fianna Fail/PD alliance short of majority.

text.p: The opposition Fianna Fail/PD alliance fell two seats short of winning a majority in parliament, according to final results of the poll.
They showed that Bertie Ahern's Fianna Fail and Mary Harney's Progressive Democrats collected 81 seats and would need the support of Independents to have a majority in the house.
But Ahern said he was confident that parliament would elect him Prime Minister when it reconvenes on June 26.
His centre-right pairing with the Progressive Democrats ended Prime Minister John Bruton's two and a half year-old centre-left "Rainbow Coalition."
Ahern said his priorities would be to cut taxes, crime and tackle the Northern Ireland conflict.
